gloss: to tear, to split, to rip

definitions.explanation: To come apart or be divided.

examples.japanese: ⟦{傷口|きずぐち}→傷口：09517_kizuguchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{裂|さ}けた。
⟦{地面|じめん}→地面：00125_jimen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧{裂|さ}けて、⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: The ground split wide open, and water came out from inside.

notes:
{裂|さ}ける means to tear, split, or rip apart (happening on its own).

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive)
- Pair: {裂|さ}く (transitive - to tear something)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {布|ぬの}が{裂|さ}ける: cloth tears
- {傷口|きずぐち}が{裂|さ}ける: a wound splits open
- {皮|かわ}が{裂|さ}ける: skin splits
- {口|くち}が{裂|さ}けても: even if my mouth splits (= never, under any circumstances)

ASPECT (ている):
{裂|さ}けている indicates the resulting state of being torn/split.

HOMOPHONE DISTINCTION:
- {裂|さ}ける: to tear, split
- {避|さ}ける: to avoid
- {割|さ}ける: to be able to spare/allocate
